entities.name: Bùi Thanh Sơn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bùi Thanh Sơn is a Vietnamese politician. He is currently the Deputy Prime Minister since 2024 and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, serving since 2021. He is also a member of the 13th Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, a member of the National Assembly for the 15th term (2021–2026), representing the Vĩnh Phúc delegation, a member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee of Central Agencies Bloc, Secretary of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and a member of the National Defense and Security Council.
